propositions: Test uses wall-clock threading.Timer to delete planted index.lock, but on slow runners (macOS py3.13) the timer fires while git commit holds its own real index.lock, causing fatal write failure.
Test deletes git's legitimate index.lock mid-commit because timer body has no identity check to distinguish planted lock from git's own lock.
Test timing failure only reproduces on macOS py3.13 CI leg under load (23m vs 12m Linux legs); Linux legs pass same tree, ruling out code defect.
Fix uses gitutil._retry_probe deterministic seam instead of wall-clock timer to release planted lock only after first failure is confirmed, eliminating ability to delete git's real lock.
Production backoff path with force_reclaim=True is correct; failure is test-local race, not a store or backoff algorithm defect.
